title: TechnicalAnalysisAgentInput
description: Pre-market snapshot for a single ticker. Field names and nesting align with technical-output-schema-ai.json where applicable. Tier-1 = required static anchors the agent must never fabricate. Tier-2 = recommended, sharpen analysis quality. Tier-3 = optional context enrichers.

symbol.description: TIER-1. Uppercase stock ticker symbol. Ground truth — copied verbatim to output.symbol. Do not alter.

as_of.description: TIER-1. ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone at which this snapshot was captured (e.g. 2026-07-01T13:15:00Z). The agent derives the output `date` field (DD-MM-YYYY) from this value. Anchors all recency reasoning.

pre_market_price.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Latest pre-market traded price. Basis for entry_range, tp_range, sl_range, and all levels computation. Do not verify, fetch, or override.

pre_market_change_pct.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Pre-market % change vs prev_close (e.g. 1.34 = +1.34%). Must be internally consistent with pre_market_price. Feeds the `relative_strength` output field when compared against benchmark.pre_market_change_pct.

pre_market_volume.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Cumulative pre-market shares traded (absolute integer, e.g. 781000 not '781K'). Feeds the `volume` output field.

market_cap.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Market capitalization in USD (absolute number, e.g. 15570000000 not '15.57B'). Informs analysis_strategy, data_quality, and institutional context in reason_3.

atr.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Average True Range. Feeds levels.stop_loss sizing, sl_range, and risk_reward_ratio. Period and timeframe are required so stop sizing is unambiguous.

value.description: ATR value in price units (same currency as pre_market_price).

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe the ATR was computed on. '1d' ATR sets the day's expected range; intraday ATR sizes intraday stops.

benchmark.description: TIER-1. Index reference (typically SPY) required to populate the `relative_strength` output field. If absent, the agent must set relative_strength to 'benchmark data unavailable'.

pre_market_change_pct.description: Benchmark pre-market % change vs its own prev_close.

levels.description: TIER-1. Price-level anchors. Mirrors the `levels` object in the output schema. Required sub-fields are the structural reference points the agent cannot reliably web-search. Tier-2 sub-fields (vwap_reference, poc, vah, val, premarket range) sharpen the levels output. Do not fabricate any numeric level.

prev_day_high.description: TIER-1. Prior regular-session high. Primary intraday resistance and breakout reference → agent uses to set levels.key_resistance in output.

prev_day_low.description: TIER-1. Prior regular-session low. Primary intraday support and breakdown reference → agent uses to set levels.key_support in output.

prev_close.description: TIER-2. Prior regular-session official closing price. Baseline for gap % calculation and internal consistency check of pre_market_change_pct.

premarket_high.description: TIER-2. Pre-market session high so far. May override prev_day_high as levels.key_resistance if structurally significant.

premarket_low.description: TIER-2. Pre-market session low so far. May override prev_day_low as levels.key_support if structurally significant.

vwap_reference.description: TIER-2. Volume-weighted average price of the prior regular session → direct pass-through to levels.vwap_reference in output. Today's session VWAP does not exist yet at pre-market.

poc.description: TIER-2. Volume Profile Point of Control (price of highest traded volume) → direct pass-through to levels.poc in output. If absent, levels.poc in output must be null — do not estimate.

vah.description: TIER-2. Value Area High → direct pass-through to levels.vah in output.

val.description: TIER-2. Value Area Low → direct pass-through to levels.val in output.

prev_day_open.description: TIER-3. Prior regular-session open. Useful for inside-day / outside-day structural context.

volume.description: TIER-2. Volume context. Provides the raw figures the agent uses to populate the `volume` output field. If omitted, the agent must state that RVOL could not be computed.

avg_daily_volume_20d.description: TIER-2. 20-day average daily volume (absolute shares). Denominator and baseline for relative-volume reasoning.

rvol_premarket.description: TIER-2. Pre-computed time-adjusted relative volume: cumulative pre-market volume up to as_of divided by the N-day average cumulative volume to the same clock-time (N=10..20). Provide this so the agent does not estimate RVOL from data it lacks.

short_float.description: TIER-2. Percentage of float sold short (e.g. 12.5 = 12.5%) → feeds the `short_float` output string. Report date is carried in short_data_as_of. These update on exchange schedule (bi-monthly/quarterly); pass most recent reported value.

short_ratio.description: TIER-2. Days-to-cover (short interest / avg daily volume) → feeds the `short_ratio` output string. Report date is carried in short_data_as_of.

institutional_holding.description: TIER-2. Institutional ownership percentage from latest 13F (e.g. 74.2 = 74.2%) → feeds the `institutional_holding` output string. Report date is carried in short_data_as_of.

short_data_as_of.description: TIER-2. Report date (YYYY-MM-DD) for short_float, short_ratio, and institutional_holding figures. The agent appends this date to each of those output strings so recency is explicit.

rsi_14_daily.description: TIER-2. 14-period daily RSI (0-100). Feeds HTF momentum context in analysis_strategy and conviction_detect.

ema.description: TIER-2. Daily EMA values for higher-timeframe bias determination. Used in analysis_strategy and reason_1. Set members to null if unavailable.

fifty_two_week_high.description: TIER-3. 52-week high. Provides macro-level resistance context for analysis_strategy.

fifty_two_week_low.description: TIER-3. 52-week low. Provides macro-level support context for analysis_strategy.

float_shares.description: TIER-3. Free-float share count (absolute). Required to compute squeeze_risk accurately when short_float is provided.

sector.description: TIER-3. GICS sector. Feeds macro-regime and institutional alignment assessment in reason_3.

next_earnings_date.description: TIER-3. Next scheduled earnings date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null. Flags event risk; populates the `notes` output field with an earnings caveat.

notes.description: TIER-3. Pre-existing data caveats, cross-source variance flags, or trader context to carry verbatim into the `notes` output field. Empty string or null if none.
